scenes.title: The problem
scenes.narration: Every day, people send cryptocurrency to wallets they know little about. And when something goes wrong, getting that money back may be impossible.
scenes.visual: Abstract wallet address and transfer line, freeze before transfer; ONE WRONG ADDRESS. YOUR CRYPTO COULD BE GONE.

scenes.title: Introducing TxGuard
scenes.narration: Meet TxGuard. A Web3 recipient-checking tool that helps you understand available wallet risk evidence before sending your crypto.
scenes.visual: Actual deployed homepage, scanner push-in and existing product logo; KNOW BEFORE YOU SEND.

scenes.title: The scanning experience
scenes.narration: Choose a blockchain, enter a public wallet address, and run a scan. TxGuard retrieves available security intelligence and blockchain activity, with missing coverage kept visible.
scenes.visual: Recorded actual chain selection, address entry, request/loading and completed 95/100 current provider assessment from the live production website.

scenes.title: Understand the evidence
scenes.narration: Review the findings, their sources, and the limits of the check in plain English. Available explanations stay grounded in retrieved evidence. No assessment can guarantee safety.
scenes.visual: Actual report category/signals, working explanation with its real source label, actual available transaction history and locally saved multi-wallet dashboard. Do not describe deterministic fallback as live AI inference.

scenes.title: Five networks
scenes.narration: Five networks: Ethereum, BNB Chain, Solana, Bitcoin, and Stacks. Security coverage varies by network.
scenes.visual: Actual selector and real interface close-ups; five network names with legible coverage note.

scenes.title: Existing Stacks record
scenes.narration: Inspect an existing scan record on Stacks Mainnet. A public receipt records an assertion; it does not certify the score.
scenes.visual: Actual read-only existing receipt verification and explorer; label EXISTING RECORD. Never connect it to the current scan as if bound together. No new paid write.

scenes.title: Everyday impact
scenes.narration: Built for P2P traders, freelancers, and everyday crypto users.
scenes.visual: Actual mobile website in restrained phone framing; no fabricated device screen or fake balance.

scenes.title: Product reveal
